label: Zyxel PMG3000-D20B GPON SFP ONT
description: mini-GPON ONT in an SFP module (Lantiq PEB98035, 64 MB RAM / 8 MB SPI NOR (GigaDevice GD25Q64B) flash, OpenWrt 12.09 (kernel 3.10.12) / 14.07 (kernel 3.10.49)) that presents to the host as 2.5G Ethernet; GPON line rate 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up on sc-apc with no LAN ports and no Wi-Fi, managed over web UI + SSH + serial.
